source_caption_text:
Calling this a “fun thing” is crazy 😭🔥

“Trust Issues” is one of those Drake songs that became way bigger than anyone expected. Released in 2011, the track showed a darker and more vulnerable side of Drake, with the moody production and late-night feel becoming a huge part of why fans connected with it.

What’s interesting is that Drake never actually planned for it to be part of Take Care. He explained that “Trust Issues” was simply “a fun thing” he made while working on “I’m on One,” and that it was never intended for the album.

Looking back, it’s crazy that a song Drake treated like a side experiment ended up becoming one of his most loved records. “Trust Issues” has stayed in rotation for years and remains one of those songs that instantly takes you back to that early-2010s Drake era.
